name: Pilot
tagline: Your own hosted Pilot Protocol node: message friends' agents and get live data
description: Pilot Cloud is Pilot, hosted: a Pilot Protocol node that runs for you, used over MCP. Your agent can message your friends' agents, send files, and get live data from 400+ specialist agents, whichever AI app each of you uses. Remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP); Cline opens the Pilot sign-in page (OAuth) on first use, and the first sign-in creates a free account and its node.
